died.name: Jonathan Swift
died.cause: referring to George Frideric Handel, who had come to visit him
died.last_words: Ah! A German and a genius! A prodigy-admit him!

died.name: Józef Poniatowski
died.desc: Polish general and Marshal of the Empire
died.cause: While he was covering the French Army's retreat during the Battle of Leipzig, French forces prematurely blew up the only bridge over the White Elster before Poniatowski could reach it
died.last_words: Gentlemen, it behoves us now to die with honour.

died.name: Robert Hugh Benson
died.desc: AFSC KC*SG KGCHS, English Roman Catholic priest and author
died.last_words: Arthur, don't look at me! Nurse stand between my brother and me.... Jesus, Mary and Joseph, I give you my heart and my soul.

born.name: John Adams
born.desc: Founding Father and second president of the United States
born.cause: unaware that Jefferson had died earlier that same day

born.name: Matangini Hazra
born.cause: repeatedly chanting words from protest song while being shot by British Indian police at the age of 72

born.name: Ronald Clark O'Bryan
born.desc: American optician who killed his son with poisoned Halloween candy for life insurance money
born.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
born.last_words: What is about to transpire in a few moments is wrong! However, we as human beings do make mistakes and errors. This execution is one of those wrongs yet doesn't mean our whole system of justice is wrong. Therefore, I would forgive all who have taken part in any way in my death. Also, to anyone I have offended in any way during my 39 years, I pray and ask your forgiveness, just as I forgive anyone who offended me in any way. And I pray and ask God's forgiveness for all of us respectively as human beings. To my loved ones, I extend my undying love. To those close to me, know in your hearts I love you one and all. God bless you all and may God's best blessings be always yours. Ronald C. O'Bryan. P.S. During my time here, I have been treated well by all T.D.C. personnel.
